problem: BPZ t=9 obstruction-free auxiliary reconfiguration in C7^5

exact_reconfiguration.move_definition: neutral k-for-k exchange inside C7^5\D, preserving an independent set of size 366

completeness_notes: The radius-1/2 component was enumerated with exact sorted 366-vertex state keys, not a hash-only equality test.
For radius 3, every owner triple that can be the union of candidate blocker supports of size at most 3 was generated from support-3 keys, support-2 plus support-1 unions, and pairs of support-2 keys.

For radius 4, every relevant owner quad was generated from support-4 keys, pair unions of support<=3 keys, and triple unions of support<=2 keys. The starting-state count 25042 independently matches the relevant-owner-quad count from the separate exact improving-exchange implementation.
For each owner set, the candidate pool consists of every allowed outside vertex whose blocker support is a nonempty subset of that owner set; all pairwise-compatible k-tuples were tested exactly.

No statement here is an upper bound on alpha(C7^5 minus D); it only proves that this particular obstruction-free 366-set sits in a six-state neutral reconfiguration island for exchange radius at most 4.
conclusion: Direct improving exchanges are already excluded through remove-5/add-6, and neutral exchanges of radius at most 4 cannot leave the six-state island around BPZ X minus 10665. A successful auxiliary 367-set must use a deeper neutral rearrangement or a different basin/component.
